name: sheen-text
title: Sheen Text
description: A word or short phrase painted with a slow, travelling gradient: the one word of a headline that carries the promise. Use it once per view, on a few words, never on body text.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/sheen-text

Installed to `components/ui/effects/sheen-text.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/effects/sheen-text';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/sheen-text

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
